name: Sorcerer's Golem
source:
In a fantasy world filled with magic and chivalry, a lone sorcerer creates a forbidden form of life, that's you, a Golem.  But were you made perhaps for some nefarious plot? To crush your master's enemies? To slay dragons?  Nope, you are a product of boredom and loneliness. For your master needs someone to listen to his monologues and play board games. That is, until he reveals unto you his biggest secret. Will you help him or destroy him? That's up to you to decide.

[From [url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/sorcerer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一個充滿魔法與騎士精神的奇幻世界裡，一位孤獨的術士創造了被禁止的生命形態：魔像，也就是你。把你造出來，是不是為了什麼險惡的陰謀？替主人消滅仇敵？去屠龍？都不是。他只是又無聊又寂寞，需要有人聽他自說自話，陪他下下棋。直到有一天，他向你透露了自己最大的秘密。你會幫他，還是毀了他？這要由你決定。

（來源：[url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/sorcerer]itch.io[/url]）
